'''Melan's office''' was the personal office from which [[Bothan Spynet/Legends|Bothan Spynet]] member [[Koth Melan]] conducted his business. The office was located in the [[Intergalactic Trade Mission]] in [[Drev'starn]], [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]].
